title.text: Tracker — screens, features & the React you'll practice

n1.text:
ISSUES LIST — features
• Table of 10,000 seeded issues: ID, priority, title, labels, status, assignee, updated
• Search box filters as you type (title + ID)
• Filter chips for status, assignee, label, priority: removable and saved in the URL
• Sort by priority / updated / created
• Click a row to open the issue; J/K moves the selection
• Live toast when someone else changes an issue (mock WebSocket)
• Counter shows how many rows are actually rendered

REACT YOU'LL PRACTICE
• Lists & keys, controlled inputs
• useDeferredValue / useTransition for search
• Virtualization (TanStack Virtual, or build your own)
• React.memo on IssueRow, moving state down
• Custom hook: useUrlState for filters
• Profiler + Performance Tracks: measure before/after

n2.text:
ISSUE DETAIL — features
• Inline-editable title and markdown description
• Properties: status, priority, assignee, labels, due date
• Sub-issues checklist
• Comments appear instantly as 'Sending…' and roll back if the API fails
• Activity log of every change
• Undo toast after each edit (⌘Z / ⇧⌘Z)
• Attachments panel has its own error boundary with Retry
• Comments load behind a Suspense skeleton

REACT YOU'LL PRACTICE
• useReducer + a history stack for undo/redo
• useOptimistic for comments and status
• use() + Suspense for comments
• Error boundaries
• useRef to focus the title when editing
• useLayoutEffect to position property popovers

n3.text:
BOARD — features
• One column per status, with counts
• Drag cards between columns and reorder inside a column
• Drop placeholder shows where the card will land
• Same filters as the list (shared state)
• Collapse a column; warning when a column passes its WIP limit
• Live updates move cards in real time

REACT YOU'LL PRACTICE
• Sharing state across views (context or an external store)
• useSyncExternalStore for your own issue store
• Stable keys while items move (index-as-key bug drill)
• Pointer events + useRef for drag state without re-rendering every frame
• lazy() + Suspense: the board is its own code-split chunk

n4.text:
NEW ISSUE — features
• Opens with C or the New issue button; Esc closes and focus returns to the button
• Fields: title, description, status, priority, assignee, labels
• Validation errors come back from the fake API
• Submit shows a pending state; fields are disabled while saving
• 'Create more' keeps the modal open and resets the form
• Draft survives an accidental close

REACT YOU'LL PRACTICE
• Form actions: useActionState + useFormStatus
• useId for label/input pairs
• createPortal for the modal, focus trap with refs
• Controlled vs. uncontrolled inputs
• Custom hook: useLocalStorageDraft

n5.text:
COMMAND PALETTE — features
• Opens with ⌘K from anywhere
• Fuzzy search across actions and issues
• Actions for the selected issue: move status, assign, change priority
• Arrow keys move the highlight, Enter runs, Esc closes
• Recent commands shown first

REACT YOU'LL PRACTICE
• useImperativeHandle to expose open() / focus()
• A global keyboard-shortcut hook with effect cleanup
• useMemo for ranking (then compare with React Compiler)
• useTransition so typing never blocks
• Accessible listbox pattern (aria-activedescendant)

n6.text:
SETTINGS & PERFORMANCE LAB — features
• Profile, theme (light / dark / system), notification toggles
• Offline banner + queue of changes waiting to sync
• Performance lab: dataset size, network latency, API failure rate, socket update speed
• Switches to turn virtualization and memoization on/off so you can compare in the Profiler
• Bug drills: switch on a planted bug (stale closure, missing cleanup, index keys, render loop) and hunt it down

REACT YOU'LL PRACTICE
• Splitting context (theme / user / settings) to avoid re-renders
• useSyncExternalStore for navigator.onLine
• Effect cleanup; StrictMode double-invoke
• React Compiler on vs. off
• DevTools Profiler + Performance Tracks
